name: Era = reign (owner decision T) on the 15 km Japan map at standard speed: 48 engine eras (Tenbun to Chidai) of the reigns' lengths, the tree headers and era names are reign names, the engine era changes exactly at Koji (turn 66) and Eiroku (turn 73) in GameCore and InGame, the ledger judges on those turns, the era-name change screen appears once per change while the official new-era screen stays hidden, and the official era score and ages stay off (to turn 75)

steps.code: local n = 0; for _ in GameInfo.Eras() do n = n + 1 end; if n ~= 48 then error('eras ' .. n) end; local cd = GameInfo.GlobalParameters['NEXT_ERA_TURN_COUNTDOWN']; if cd == nil or tostring(cd.Value) ~= '1' then error('countdown parameter ' .. tostring(cd and cd.Value)) end; local function len(t) local x = GameInfo.Eras_XP1[t]; return x and (tostring(x.GameEraMinimumTurns) .. '/' .. tostring(x.GameEraMaximumTurns)) or 'none' end; local got = len('ERA_ANCIENT') .. ' ' .. len('ERA_CLASSICAL') .. ' ' .. len('ERA_MEDIEVAL') .. ' ' .. len('ERA_JAC_CHIDAI'); if got ~= '65/65 7/7 37/37 nil/nil' then error('era lengths ' .. got) end; local e = GameInfo.Eras; if e['ERA_ANCIENT'].Name ~= 'LOC_JAC_ERA_TENBUN_NAME' or e['ERA_CLASSICAL'].Name ~= 'LOC_JAC_ERA_KOJI_NAME' or e['ERA_MEDIEVAL'].Name ~= 'LOC_JAC_ERA_EIROKU_NAME' then error('official eras not renamed') end; local r = GameInfo.JAC_SengokuReigns; if r['REIGN_KOJI'].EraType ~= 'ERA_CLASSICAL' or r['REIGN_EIROKU'].EraType ~= 'ERA_MEDIEVAL' or r['REIGN_CHIDAI'].EraType ~= 'ERA_JAC_CHIDAI' then error('reign eras') end; local era = Game.GetEras():GetCurrentEra(); if era ~= 0 then error('GameCore era ' .. tostring(era)) end; return 'turn 1: 48 eras (Tenbun to Chidai), Tenbun 65, Koji 7, Eiroku 37 turns, Chidai endless, countdown 1, GameCore era 0'

local elapsed = Game.GetCurrentGameTurn() - GameConfiguration.GetStartTurn() + 1; if elapsed ~= 1 then error('not turn 1: ' .. elapsed) end; local eras = Game.GetEras(); for _, p in ipairs(PlayerManager.GetAliveMajors()) do local id = p:GetID(); if eras:GetPlayerCurrentScore(id) ~= 0 then error('official era score for ' .. id) end; if eras:HasGoldenAge(id) or eras:HasDarkAge(id) or eras:HasHeroicGoldenAge(id) then error('official age for ' .. id) end end; local start = GameConfiguration.GetStartTurn(); if eras:GetCurrentEra() ~= 0 then error('engine era ' .. tostring(eras:GetCurrentEra()) .. ', expected 0') end; local first, last = eras:GetCurrentEraStartTurn() - start + 1, eras:GetCurrentEraMaximumEndTurn() - start + 1; if last ~= 66 then error('era ends on turn ' .. last .. ', expected 66') end; local name = Locale.Lookup(GameInfo.Eras[0].Name); if name ~= Locale.Lookup('LOC_JAC_ERA_TENBUN_NAME') or not string.find(name, Locale.Lookup('LOC_JAC_REIGN_TENBUN_NAME'), 1, true) then error('era name ' .. name) end; return 'turn 1: engine era 0 (' .. name .. ') from turn ' .. first .. ' to turn ' .. last .. ', countdown ' .. tostring(eras:GetNextEraCountdown()) .. '; official era score 0 and no official age'
